profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Specialties: Python, Automation, Quality Assurance, Solar PV, Data acquisition

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Developed, improved, and maintained Python-based automation infrastructure for UI testing with Selenium and API testing with Requests. Developed cross-platform mobile testing framework using Appium and Python. Developed test automation triage tools using Javascript, jQuery, and Firebase. Performed code reviews. Trained and on-boarded colleagues in testing and programming. Managed Jenkins continuous integration platform for automated tests. Developed test automation triage tools using Python, Javascript, jQuery, and Firebase.

Technologies used: Python, Scala, Play, Salesforce, Apex, Visualforce, Javascript, jQuery, Angular, Typescript, PHP, Jenkins, Github, AWS, Selenium, Appium, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Assembla, Jira, Confluence

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description: Lead QA on cross-functional scrum team. Developed requirements and acceptance criteria for new software features. Performed manual testing for new features to ensure correct and bug-free operation. Performed regression testing on all areas of Sungevity’s software platform. Wrote automated tests and contributed to existing test automation framework.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description: Managed all aspects of PV system monitoring and fleet performance for approximately 20,000 residential solar installations nationwide. Developed, improved, and maintained fleet performance analysis tools using SQL, Javascript, VBA, PHP, and R.

positions.title: Service Project manager
positions.description: Managed all aspects of service work for approximately 20,000 residential solar installations nationwide. Developed and implemented processes, documentation, and infrastructure in a rapidly growing company. Trained new hires on all aspects of solar service work.

positions.title: PV Service Manager
positions.description: Performed troubleshooting and repairs on solar photovoltaic systems. Managed other technicians, worked with clients. Oversaw the company's monitoring system infrastructure.

positions.title: Superintendent
positions.description: Worked with PV installation crews and office staff to ensure quality, safe, and efficient PV system installations.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Worked with clients and all departments in the company to coordinate design and installation of PV systems. Managed schedules, contracts, and budgets.

positions.title: Foreman
positions.description: Was responsible for the proper installation of PV systems and the safety of crew members. Oversaw and performed installation and troubleshooting. Taught classes on PV system design and installation.

positions.title: Warehouse Manager
positions.description: Ordered equipment for projects, managed inventory and expenses.

positions.title: PV Installer
positions.description: Installed PV systems under supervision of foreman. Procured permits and performed inspections and service calls.

positions.title: Assembly Technician
positions.description: Assembled motor and motor control systems for marine water filtration units. Developed assembly manuals from scratch.

honors.title: Best Band
honors.description: Contributing member to the Killa Watts, voted Best Band at the Solar Battle of the Bands (part of Intersolar solar industry conference), 3 consecutive years 2013-2015.
